summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release disclosing a NI 43-101 compliant mineral reserve estimate and updated project economics for its Moss Mine in Arizona. The report details 598 koz Au and 6.30 Moz Ag reserves in 56.8 Mt grading 0.327 g/t Au and 3.45 g/t Ag, supporting a post-tax NPV5% of $254M at base-case $3,500/oz gold. This is a routine operational update disclosing technical information, not a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate action is announced. The filing is a standard current report by a foreign private issuer.
